name: Vertex Search
instructions:
### Rules
- A lesson does not store its parent course. Derive it with `*[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0]`.
- Module and lesson numbers (e.g. Lesson 5.1) are positional, derived from course.modules[] and modules[].lessons[] order. They are never stored.
- notes on lesson is Portable Text. It cannot be text-matched directly; match `pt::text(notes)`.
- duration is in seconds.

### Video Intelligence & Timestamps
- video documents are an internal lookup, never a standalone result. Tie a matched video back to the lesson whose videoUrl equals the video URL.
- Resolve video moments in two stages: match chapters[].label first, fall back to chunks[].text only when no chapter matches.
- Never project a whole chunks or chapters array (to avoid context overflow). Filter inside projection and take at most 3 matches.
- The video type may hold zero documents. Return lesson matches only and never invent a timestamp.

### Query Patterns & Fallbacks
- Text match in GROQ: Wildcard tokens (e.g. 'react*') and check topic presence in title, module title, and notes: count($terms[^.title match @ || pt::text(^.notes) match @ || ^.keyPoints[] match @]) > 0.
- If text::semanticSimilarity() errors with embeddings not enabled, fall back to wildcard keyword matching.
